subject: Fix integer overflow in SORT BY/GET pattern key substitution (#5146)
reason: The fix only changes behaviour when prefixlen+sublen+postfixlen of the SORT BY/GET substituted key reaches 2^31: as int it overflowed to a negative value that sign-extended to ~2^64 as size_t and caused an OOM crash, while below 2^31 the int and size_t arithmetic are identical, so parent and fixed builds reply byte-for-byte the same. Triggering the overflow requires a ~2 GiB command argument (a set/list member or a BY/GET pattern around the '*'), exactly as the project's own large-memory test does with proto-max-bulk-len raised to 3 GB and write_big_bulk of INT_MAX+2 bytes.
